name: Budapest Metropolitan University
summary: Budapest university with English-taught bachelor's degrees in art and design, business, communication and tourism, entered by online interview.

ib.text: No IB points rule: finish secondary school with overall marks above 50%. English is judged in a compulsory online interview (IELTS 5.5 or TOEFL 69 accepted, not required); art degrees need a portfolio.

programmes.name: Animation
programmes.about: Animation film from drawing to motion picture: design of characters and backgrounds, animation techniques, film tricks and games or apps; prior drawing or software experience helps but is not required.
programmes.ib: Portfolio of animation, drawing or other visual work, a motivation letter, CV and a statement that the work is your own.
programmes.selectionNote: Portfolio with motivation letter and CV, then a compulsory online interview that also checks your English. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Environmental Design
programmes.about: Design of spaces and objects with an ecological approach, taught through personal consultation and workshops where you build prototypes in the in-house workshop.
programmes.ib: Portfolio with up to 20 drawings, up to 5 concept sketches or mock-ups and figure drawings, plus CV and motivation letter.
programmes.selectionNote: Portfolio with motivation letter and CV, then a compulsory online interview that also checks your English. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Film and Media Studies
programmes.about: Film history and theory with hands-on courses in directing, scriptwriting, cinematography, editing, sound and production management, in an international group.
programmes.ib: Portfolio, a short motivation letter about your background and why film and media, and a statement of ownership for the work.
programmes.selectionNote: Portfolio with motivation letter and CV, then a compulsory online interview that also checks your English. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

separateFrom.name: Communication and Media Studies
separateFrom.reason: Film and Media Studies is an art degree in filmmaking (portfolio entry, EUR 3,990 a semester); Communication and Media Studies is a social-science degree entered by interview (EUR 3,200).

programmes.name: Graphic Design
programmes.about: Graphic design from illustration to book, identity and poster design, branding and packaging, moving to interactive and responsive work in the third year.
programmes.ib: Single PDF portfolio combining scanned handmade and digital work, plus a short motivation letter and a statement of ownership.
programmes.selectionNote: Portfolio with motivation letter and CV, then a compulsory online interview that also checks your English. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Media Design
programmes.about: Screen graphics, motion pictures, sound, 3D and game design, UX, visual effects and interactive installations, with the first year on visual logic and composition.
programmes.ib: Portfolio of drawings, images, sound, video or animation up to 5 minutes, interactive work or games that shows your professional competencies.
programmes.selectionNote: Portfolio with motivation letter and CV, then a compulsory online interview that also checks your English. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Communication and Media Studies
programmes.about: Communication theory, mass media, psychology and marketing, then a specialisation in International Communication or Integrated Media from the third semester.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents and school results screened, then a compulsory online interview that also checks your English. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: International Relations
programmes.about: International, intercultural and transnational relations, with professional use of foreign languages, for careers in the international arena.
programmes.selectionNote: Online interview with extra questions on current global issues. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Human Resource Management
programmes.about: HR processes and people: recruitment and selection, training, incentives and how technology is changing work (210 ECTS).
programmes.selectionNote: Documents and school results screened, then a compulsory online interview. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: International Business Economics
programmes.about: EU integration and policies, world economic regions, foreign trade, international economics and finance and negotiation techniques (240 ECTS).
programmes.selectionNote: Documents and school results screened, then a compulsory online interview. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Business Administration and Management
programmes.about: Management and business knowledge with analytical and organisational skills for running business processes (210 ECTS).
programmes.ib: Online Maths test as part of the admission interview; the test is set on your overall school results.
programmes.selectionNote: Online interview plus a 30-minute online Maths test, set by your overall school results. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Commerce and Marketing
programmes.about: Business and economics with commerce and marketing: brands, selling and group practical training (210 ECTS).
programmes.ib: Online Maths test as part of the admission interview; the test is set on your overall school results.
programmes.selectionNote: Online interview plus a 30-minute online Maths test, set by your overall school results. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Finance and Accounting
programmes.about: Corporate finance, capital markets and financial processes, taught analytically with the latest financial tools and software (210 ECTS).
programmes.ib: Online Maths test as part of the admission interview; the test is set on your overall school results.
programmes.selectionNote: Online interview plus a 30-minute online Maths test, set by your overall school results. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Tourism and Catering
programmes.about: Tourism and catering in Budapest, with third-year specialisations in Health Tourism or International Hotel Management (240 ECTS).
programmes.ib: Online Maths test as part of the admission interview; the test is set on your overall school results.
programmes.selectionNote: Online interview plus a 30-minute online Maths test, set by your overall school results. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: EU students pay the EU fee, which METU says includes EU and EEA member states and Turkey: EUR 2,800 to 3,990 a semester against EUR 3,500 to 4,990 for non-EU applicants; two semesters are paid up front.
The fee table for 2026/27 is indexed to Hungarian inflation, so it may rise each year; a EUR 150 application fee is non-refundable.
